per_a_sync_counts.note: Per-type sync counts for the middle 11 canonical a-types were not individually retained; only the cumulative first-12 total and the three rows above are logged. Totals are exact.

exactness_scope: Maximum is exact over the b-permutation sub-slice (every isomorphism class with b a permutation meets canonical-a x all-perm-b exactly once up to simultaneous relabeling). It is a lower bound for the full slice (arbitrary b).

ils_kick_search.moves: 1-3 random swaps (perm-preserving) or 1-2 point mutations (general), occasional random a-type

method.bfs: power-automaton BFS on 256 bitmask subsets, forward from FULL {0..7} and reverse from 8 singletons; parent pointers give shortest word; pair-automaton BFS on 64 pairs for synchronizability prefilter
